questions.question: Django MTV pattern là gì?

options.A: Model-Template-View giống MVC nhưng controller là View (logic), template là View (presentation)
options.B: Django không có architectural pattern

questions.explanation: MTV: Model (database schema, ORM), Template (HTML presentation), View (business logic, handle request/response). Django URL dispatcher → View → Model → Template. Khác MVC: Django's View = MVC Controller, Django's Template = MVC View. settings.py: INSTALLED_APPS, DATABASES, TEMPLATES. manage.py: runserver, migrate, makemigrations, createsuperuser, shell.

questions.question: Django ORM — Model definition và migrations?

options.B: class Model(models.Model) với field types; makemigrations tạo migration files; migrate apply to DB; admin auto-registration

questions.explanation: class Post(models.Model): title = models.CharField(max_length=200); body = models.TextField(); author = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE); created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True); published = models.BooleanField(default=False). class Meta: ordering = ['-created_at']; indexes = [models.Index(fields=['author', 'published'])]. Migrations: python manage.py makemigrations → migration files. python manage.py migrate → apply. QuerySet: Post.objects.filter(published=True).select_related('author').order_by('-created_at').

questions.question: Django REST Framework (DRF) Serializers?

options.B: Serializers convert Model instances to/from JSON; ModelSerializer auto-generates fields; validation; nested serializers; HyperlinkedModelSerializer

questions.explanation: class PostSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer): author_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField(); class Meta: model = Post; fields = ['id', 'title', 'body', 'author_name', 'created_at']; read_only_fields = ['id', 'created_at']. def get_author_name(self, obj): return obj.author.get_full_name(). Validation: def validate_title(self, value): if len(value) < 5: raise serializers.ValidationError('Too short'); return value. Nested: PostSerializer với CommentSerializer(many=True, read_only=True). serialize: serializer.data. deserialize: serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True); serializer.save().

questions.question: Django URL patterns và Class-Based Views?

options.B: urlpatterns với path()/re_path(); CBVs: APIView, ListAPIView, ModelViewSet; router.register cho DRF ViewSets; permissions, authentication

questions.explanation: urls.py: from rest_framework.routers import DefaultRouter; router = DefaultRouter(); router.register('posts', PostViewSet); urlpatterns = [path('api/', include(router.urls))]. ViewSet: class PostViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet): queryset = Post.objects.all(); serializer_class = PostSerializer; permission_classes = [IsAuthenticatedOrReadOnly]; def get_queryset(self): return Post.objects.filter(author=self.request.user) if self.request.user.is_authenticated else Post.objects.filter(published=True). Actions: list, create, retrieve, update, partial_update, destroy. @action(detail=True, methods=['post']) def publish(self, request, pk=None).

questions.question: Django authentication và permissions trong DRF?

options.B: Django built-in auth, DRF authentication classes (JWT với djangorestframework-simplejwt), permission classes, IsAuthenticated, custom permissions

questions.explanation: settings.py: REST_FRAMEWORK = { 'DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES': ['rest_framework_simplejwt.authentication.JWTAuthentication'], 'DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES': ['rest_framework.permissions.IsAuthenticated'] }. simplejwt: urlpatterns += [path('api/token/', TokenObtainPairView.as_view()), path('api/token/refresh/', TokenRefreshView.as_view())]. Custom permission: class IsOwnerOrReadOnly(BasePermission): def has_object_permission(self, request, view, obj): if request.method in SAFE_METHODS: return True; return obj.author == request.user. Views: permission_classes = [IsOwnerOrReadOnly].

questions.question: Django queryset optimization — N+1 và database performance?

options.B: select_related (FK/OneToOne JOIN), prefetch_related (ManyToMany/reverse FK), only()/defer(), values(), annotate(), explain() để debug
options.C: N+1 không xảy ra với Django

questions.explanation: N+1: posts = Post.objects.all(); for post in posts: print(post.author.name) → N queries. Fix: Post.objects.all().select_related('author'). ManyToMany: Post.objects.all().prefetch_related('tags'). Complex: Post.objects.annotate(comment_count=Count('comments')).select_related('author').prefetch_related('tags'). only('id', 'title'): load chỉ specified fields. values('id', 'title'): return dicts (không ORM objects). QuerySet lazy: chỉ hit DB khi iterate/len/bool. Debug: from django.db import connection; print(connection.queries). django-silk, django-debug-toolbar cho performance profiling.

questions.question: Django signals và receivers?

options.B: Signals: post_save, pre_save, post_delete, m2m_changed; @receiver decorator; loose coupling giữa apps; weak references

questions.explanation: @receiver(post_save, sender=User) def create_user_profile(sender, instance, created, **kwargs): if created: UserProfile.objects.create(user=instance). @receiver(post_save, sender=Order) def send_order_confirmation(sender, instance, created, **kwargs): if created: send_email.delay(instance.user.email, instance.id). Ready mixin để register: class UsersConfig(AppConfig): def ready(self): import users.signals. Pitfalls: (1) signals run synchronously → heavy tasks dùng Celery. (2) Multiple saves → signal called multiple times. (3) Bulk operations (bulk_create) không trigger signals. (4) Use sparingly — can make code hard to debug.

questions.question: Django caching — cache framework?

options.B: Cache backends (Redis, Memcached, file, memory); cache_page decorator; cache.set/get/delete; template fragment caching; per-site caching

questions.explanation: settings.py: CACHES = { 'default': { 'BACKEND': 'django_redis.cache.RedisCache', 'LOCATION': 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379/1', 'OPTIONS': { 'CLIENT_CLASS': 'django_redis.client.DefaultClient' } } }. Per-view: @cache_page(60 * 15) def my_view(request): ... Low-level: from django.core.cache import cache; cache.set('key', value, timeout=3600); result = cache.get('key'); cache.delete('key'). cache_control(max_age=3600) cho HTTP cache headers. Template: {% load cache %} {% cache 3600 sidebar %} ...expensive... {% endcache %}.

questions.question: Implement Django filtering, pagination, và search trong DRF?

options.B: django-filter với DjangoFilterBackend; SearchFilter; OrderingFilter; PageNumberPagination; CursorPagination cho large datasets

questions.explanation: class PostFilter(FilterSet): author_username = CharFilter(field_name='author__username', lookup_expr='icontains'); min_date = DateFilter(field_name='created_at', lookup_expr='gte'); class Meta: model = Post; fields = ['published', 'author']. ViewSet: filter_backends = [DjangoFilterBackend, SearchFilter, OrderingFilter]; filterset_class = PostFilter; search_fields = ['title', 'body', '^author__username']; ordering_fields = ['created_at', 'title']; ordering = ['-created_at']. Pagination: class StandardPagination(PageNumberPagination): page_size = 20; page_size_query_param = 'page_size'; max_page_size = 100. REST_FRAMEWORK = { 'DEFAULT_PAGINATION_CLASS': 'myapp.pagination.StandardPagination' }.

questions.question: Django Celery integration cho background tasks?

options.B: Celery với Redis/RabbitMQ broker; @shared_task; countdown/eta; periodic tasks với celery-beat; task monitoring với Flower

questions.explanation: celery.py: app = Celery('myproject'); app.config_from_object('django.conf:settings', namespace='CELERY'); app.autodiscover_tasks(). settings.py: CELERY_BROKER_URL = 'redis://localhost:6379/0'; CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND = 'redis://localhost:6379/0'. tasks.py: @shared_task def send_welcome_email(user_id): user = User.objects.get(id=user_id); send_mail(subject='Welcome', ...). Trigger: send_welcome_email.delay(user.id) hoặc apply_async(args=[user.id], countdown=60). Beat: CELERY_BEAT_SCHEDULE = { 'daily-report': { 'task': 'tasks.generate_report', 'schedule': crontab(hour=0) } }. Run: celery -A myproject worker -l info; celery -A myproject beat.

questions.question: Django admin customization?

options.B: ModelAdmin class: list_display, list_filter, search_fields, readonly_fields, inlines, actions; custom templates; raw_id_fields

questions.explanation: @admin.register(Post) class PostAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin): list_display = ['title', 'author', 'published', 'created_at']; list_filter = ['published', 'created_at', 'author']; search_fields = ['title', 'body', 'author__username']; readonly_fields = ['created_at', 'updated_at']; raw_id_fields = ['author']; date_hierarchy = 'created_at'; list_per_page = 25; actions = ['make_published']. def make_published(self, request, queryset): queryset.update(published=True). Inline: class CommentInline(admin.TabularInline): model = Comment; extra = 0. list_display custom: def author_fullname(self, obj): return obj.author.get_full_name(). Django Suit, Jazzmin: custom admin themes.

questions.question: Django testing — TestCase, APIClient?

options.B: Django TestCase với test database; DRF APIClient; factory_boy cho test data; pytest-django; mock với unittest.mock

questions.explanation: class PostAPITest(APITestCase): def setUp(self): self.user = User.objects.create_user('john', password='pass'); self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user). def test_create_post(self): data = {'title': 'Test', 'body': 'Body content'}; response = self.client.post('/api/posts/', data, format='json'); self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED); self.assertEqual(Post.objects.count(), 1); self.assertEqual(response.data['title'], 'Test'). factory_boy: class PostFactory(factory.django.DjangoModelFactory): class Meta: model = Post; title = factory.Sequence(lambda n: f'Post {n}'). pytest-django: @pytest.mark.django_db def test_post_list(api_client): response = api_client.get('/api/posts/'); assert response.status_code == 200.

questions.question: Django N+1 queries trong production — detect và fix?

options.A: N+1 không xảy ra trong production
options.B: django-debug-toolbar (development), django-silk, logging DB queries; fix với select_related/prefetch_related; QuerySet caching

questions.explanation: Detect: (1) django-debug-toolbar: SQL panel hiển thị queries per request, similar queries. (2) Logging: LOGGING = { 'loggers': { 'django.db.backends': { 'level': 'DEBUG' } } }. (3) connection.queries count. (4) Production: django-silk → save queries per request. Fix: select_related (FK, OneToOne), prefetch_related (ManyToMany, reverse FK). QuerySet caching: qs = list(Post.objects.all()) → evaluated once. Batch: User.objects.in_bulk(user_ids). Custom manager: class PostManager(Manager): def with_stats(self): return self.annotate(comment_count=Count('comments')).

questions.question: Django migration conflicts — resolve?

options.B: squashmigrations để merge; --merge flag; manual edit migration dependencies; avoid circular dependencies giữa apps
options.C: Xóa database là cách duy nhất

questions.explanation: Conflict: hai developers tạo migration 0003 cùng lúc. python manage.py migrate --merge 0003_auto_xxx 0003_auto_yyy → tạo 0004_merge. squashmigrations: python manage.py squashmigrations myapp 0001 0020 → 1 migration thay 20. Circular: App A FK to App B, App B FK to App A → swappable_dependency. Fake migrations: python manage.py migrate --fake myapp 0003 nếu state đã trong DB. showmigrations: python manage.py showmigrations → xem applied migrations. RunPython: data migration custom code.

questions.question: Django CORS và security headers — configuration?

options.B: django-cors-headers: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS; SecurityMiddleware headers; CSRF protection; HTTPS settings

questions.explanation: INSTALLED_APPS += ['corsheaders']. MIDDLEWARE insert 'corsheaders.middleware.CorsMiddleware' TRƯỚC CommonMiddleware. CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = ['https://app.com', 'http://localhost:3000']. CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS = True. Security: SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True (production); SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 31536000; SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True; CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True; SECURE_CONTENT_TYPE_NOSNIFF = True; X_FRAME_OPTIONS = 'DENY'. django-csp: Content-Security-Policy headers. ALLOWED_HOSTS = ['api.example.com']. DEBUG = False production.

questions.question: Django deployment checklist?

options.B: DEBUG=False, ALLOWED_HOSTS, gunicorn, whitenoise cho static, DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY từ env, collectstatic, HTTPS
options.D: Apache mod_wsgi là duy nhất option

questions.explanation: Production checklist: (1) DEBUG = False. (2) ALLOWED_HOSTS = ['yourdomain.com']. (3) SECRET_KEY từ environment variable (không hardcode). (4) Database: PostgreSQL (không SQLite). (5) Static files: python manage.py collectstatic → whitenoise hoặc Nginx serve. (6) WSGI: gunicorn myproject.wsgi -w 4 --bind 0.0.0.0:8000. (7) HTTPS: SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT, HSTS. (8) Sentry error tracking. (9) Celery cho async tasks. (10) Redis cho caching. (11) python manage.py check --deploy → deployment checks. (12) Environment: django-environ hoặc python-decouple.

questions.question: Django với Docker và Kubernetes deployment?

options.B: Multi-stage Dockerfile, gunicorn entrypoint, migrations init container, health check endpoint, K8s Deployment/Service, secrets

questions.explanation: Dockerfile: FROM python:3.12-slim; WORKDIR /app; COPY requirements.txt .; RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; COPY . .; RUN python manage.py collectstatic --noinput; CMD ['gunicorn', 'myproject.wsgi:application', '-w', '4', '--bind', '0.0.0.0:8000']. Health check: urlpatterns += [path('health/', lambda r: JsonResponse({'status': 'ok'})]. K8s: init container chạy migrations: command: ['python', 'manage.py', 'migrate']. Secrets: DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY từ K8s Secrets → env vars. HPA: CPU/memory based scaling. Persistent: media files trong S3 (django-storages).

questions.question: Django performance — caching strategies cho high-traffic?

options.B: Redis caching, database query optimization, CDN cho static/media, read replicas, connection pooling (pgbouncer), async views (Django 3.1+)
options.D: Django không phù hợp cho high-traffic

questions.explanation: Caching hierarchy: (1) HTTP cache headers (cache-control, ETags). (2) Redis cache: per-view (@cache_page), per-object, fragment. (3) Database: select_related, prefetch, only(), values(), indexes, EXPLAIN ANALYZE. (4) Connection pool: pgbouncer → reduce connection overhead. (5) Read replica: DATABASE_ROUTERS cho read-heavy queries. (6) Async views: async def my_view(request) với asyncio (Django 3.1+). (7) CDN: CloudFront/Cloudflare cho static, media (S3 + CloudFront). (8) Message queue: Celery cho heavy processing. (9) Load test: locust, k6 trước deployment.

questions.question: Django multi-tenancy approach?

options.B: django-tenants (schema-per-tenant), request middleware extract tenant, SubdomainTenantMiddleware, shared vs tenant-specific schemas

questions.explanation: Approaches: (1) Schema-per-tenant (PostgreSQL): django-tenants, django-tenant-schemas. Tenant schema isolation, shared schema for public data. (2) Row-level: tenant_id FK trên tất cả models, middleware set current tenant, custom manager filter by tenant. (3) Database-per-tenant: separate connections. django-tenants setup: SHARED_APPS, TENANT_APPS, TenantMiddleware, MULTI_TENANT_DB_BACKEND. Domain: company1.app.com → Company tenant → company1 schema. TenantManager: connection.set_schema(tenant.schema_name). django-scim2 cho enterprise SSO. Performance: tenant-specific caching keys.

questions.question: Django Channels — WebSocket và real-time features?

options.B: Django Channels: ASGI, WebSocket consumer, Channel Layer (Redis), groups, async consumers, routing

questions.explanation: INSTALLED_APPS += ['channels']. ASGI_APPLICATION = 'myproject.asgi.application'. Channel Layer: CHANNEL_LAYERS = { 'default': { 'BACKEND': 'channels_redis.core.RedisChannelLayer', 'CONFIG': {'hosts': [('localhost', 6379)]} } }. Consumer: class ChatConsumer(AsyncWebsocketConsumer): async def connect(self): self.room = self.scope['url_route']['kwargs']['room_name']; await self.channel_layer.group_add(self.room, self.channel_name); await self.accept(). async def receive(self, text_data): data = json.loads(text_data); await self.channel_layer.group_send(self.room, {'type': 'chat.message', 'message': data['message']}). routing.py: WebsocketURLRouter([path('ws/chat/<room_name>/', ChatConsumer.as_asgi())]).
